Each H2 opens with the direct answer before elaborating (e.g. 'The mongkhon is the braided or corded headband...' before origin details; 'The trainer... removes the mongkhon... right before the first strike' as the first sentence of that H3). FAQ answers lead with the direct answer. The new Conclusion restates the two-object distinction in one sentence before closing, no re-litigation of the body.

Opens on a lived situation ('I have put a mongkhon on more heads than I can count'), not a generic definition, per patte-ecrite.md. First person used where Meaw's real experience applies (intro, etiquette section, Conclusion). All 4 required bold entities (mongkhon, pra jiad, muay thai headband, wai kru ram muay) appear exactly once, in natural sentence position. Secondary keywords (sealing the ring, wai kru dance, ram muay music, muay thai wai) are woven into sentences rather than listed.
